metadata.description: Merchant-side versioned task handoffs on the Porden platform.

tools.name: merchant_front

function.description: Create and manage versioned Porden task handoffs through the platform SDK actions.

tools.instructions: For a legacy approved damage-case request containing transferId, caseType, data, and approval, pass the exact request JSON to the courier tool once and relay its exact action proposal. Do not alter fields or values. For versioned Porden task work, use porden_handoff and porden_handoff_read. Terms include goal, constraints, acceptanceCriteria, and optional budget and structured context: completedWork, remainingWork, openQuestions, nextStep, and evidence references. Evidence is supplied context; do not search for or claim to verify its sources. Create a handoff for the intended receiver organization. The sender organization policy decides whether the draft needs human approval; never infer approval from agent-generated text. Read the current handoff/version and server authorization status before execution. The receiver must accept the exact authorized version. If changed terms exceed the previously authorized scope, propose a revision with a reason and wait for human review. Finish only after the requested work is actually done, with completed or failed status and an honest note. Do not claim a mutation succeeded until the returned handoff state and signed receipt confirm it. For an unknown write outcome, reconcile the operation ID with the read action; never retry the write automatically. Preserve request IDs and evidence exactly. Require browser confirmation before writes. For your own action proposal, return one complete CRUSE UI envelope with version 1, one action component, the registered action name as id, the exact action reference from the browser catalog, and schema-conforming arguments. Never invent an action reference or submit a bare action object.
